name: LuxNet Corporation
summary: LuxNet Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, and sells electronic and active components for optical communication in Taiwan. It offers optical communication laser and photodetector diode components, epitaxial wafers and chips, metal-mounted optical sub-modules, single-phase optical sub-modules, bidirectional and tridirectional optical sub-modules, high-speed optical engines, high-speed active fiber optic cables, and fiber optic communication transceiver modules. The company is also involved in the retail sale of electronic materials. Its products are used in internet, data transmission, and cable television applications.
